channel.desc: Action 2018 A unit of secret agents, led by a seasoned U.S. intelligence officer, is assigned a high-stakes mission to extract a person with critical information from Indonesia, overcoming security obstacles to ensure a safe escape. Mark Wahlberg, Lauren Cohan, Iko Uwais, John Malkovich, Ronda Rousey, Peter Berg, Graham Roland.
